summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your judgment about what's possible. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The problem is that neither of you may know when to slow down. Confidence can become overconfidence. Encouragement can start to feel like pressure. You can get so caught up in the momentum that neither of you stops to check whether the risk is worth it. The excitement is real. So are the consequences.
advice: This connection can help you step outside your comfort zone and trust yourself more. It encourages growth through action, reminding you that confidence is built by taking meaningful steps forward. Be willing to take the chance when it aligns with your goals and values. Just remember that enthusiasm is most powerful when it is paired with preparation and intention.
